mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.plate_no AS plateNo, f.identify_time AS identifyTime, f.match_scene AS matchScene, f.status, s.name AS stationName, f.station_id AS stationId, f.handle_user_id AS handleUserId, f.handle_time AS handleTime, f.handle_progress AS handleProgress, f.handle_type AS handleType, f.ignore_reason AS ignoreReason, f.remark, f.reserve1, f.reserve2, f.creator, f.updater, f.create_time AS createTime, f.update_time AS updateTime FROM fake_plate_control f LEFT JOIN station_info s ON f.station_id = s.id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE(f.identify_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM fake_plate_control f WHERE f.deleted = 0
AND f.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND f.identify_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND f.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(f.identify_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COUNT(f.id) AS count FROM fake_plate_control f LEFT JOIN station_info s ON f.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE f.deleted = 0
AND f.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND f.identify_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND f.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY f.station_id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = '未处理' OR f.status = '处理中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitHandleCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.status = '已关闭' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS handleCompleteRate FROM fake_plate_control f WHERE f.deleted = 0
AND f.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND f.identify_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND f.station_id = #{stationId}
